title: Matchmaking state
idea: Matchmaking state: Queue elapsed state and cancel action explain actual session search
audience: People who need to find match within a game surface.
avoidWhen: A timer would simulate nonexistent peers
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its find match priority and explicit commitment contract: Cancellation acknowledged by service prevents accidental joining
navigation: Matchmaking state keeps the current find match context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Queue elapsed state and cancel action explain actual session search
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to find match; a real matchmaking service exists
composition.priority: Cancellation acknowledged by service prevents accidental joining

imagery.role: Support the actual find match context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Avoid trapping focus while queue updates
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the matchmaking state structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no find match content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Cancellation acknowledged by service prevents accidental joining
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized find match content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Cancellation acknowledged by service prevents accidental joining
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active find match context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
